body: One more whole-value consequence for attempt/v2: policyDecisions currently enter through PolicyDecision.render, and Allowed delegates to RemoteCapability.render, which truncates provider and payloadDigest to 12 chars. CacheDecision.Denied embeds the same lossy display; policy/result display strings also concatenate fields without typed/tagged boundaries. Those are human renderers, not canonical identity encodings.\n\nThe v2 renderer therefore needs private typed field encoders for ProviderCall, EmbeddingReceipt, CacheDecision, PolicyDecision/RemoteCapability (full fingerprint and ReceiptDigest), ResultDecision, and EmbedError, with tagged Options, escaped individual strings, canonical doubles, and sorted map entries. Public render output stays unchanged. I will pin at least params/seed/cached and full-capability mutations; a v2 attempt digest must change whenever any field participating in AttemptReceipt equality changes.
